title.narrative: Succoring an immediate humanitarian response program for conflict and cyclone affected people in southern Chin state

description.narrative:
ltpgtltspan style="color: black font-family:"gtThe horrific situation in southern Chin state is getting worse and worse since the civil war does not seem to be at peace. Some IDPs camps in Paletwa township are still in existence though the de facto authority does not want them to live in the previous camps sites. And in other projects targeted places in Matupi and Kanplet townships, IDPs lived inconveniently in a strange place. In addition, cyclone MOCHA has damaged IDP camps and settled places in targeted project places. Targeted IDPs are now living in fear and uncertainty for their lives since the crisis and problem are doubling in their daily lives. The safety, stability, and peace for the IDPs are getting worse than better in targeted towns. Family World field staff located in Paletwa and Samee towns did a survey of IDP camps and conflict affected people situation in Matupi and Kanplet townships and did a report that shelters and NFI kits, and food security are most needed things due to cyclone MOCHA. Furthermore, educationally, this political unrest has badly affected children’s education. Schools that are opened under de facto authority have not enough teachers and the school’s lessons have not been taught completely. But children jumped from lower grade to higher grade without a well-informed education. Non-Food Items like mosquito nets, toothbrushes and toothpastes, mats, torchlights, women sanitary, soap and washing powder etc are essentially needed as they are now facing the rainy season. Targeted displaced and affected people especially in Matupi and Kanplet townships are now in need of daily feeding due to lack of food storage and hard transportation conditions. lt/spangtltspan style="color: black font-family:"gt lt/spangtltbrgtlt/pgtltp class="" style=""gt
lt/pgtltp class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:9.95pt"gtltspan style="font-size:8.0pt mso-bidi-font-size:10.0ptfont-family:"gtTherefore, Family World would like to step up and step in forward to help all the targeted affected people so that no affected people should be left behind from this assistance. We aim to directly assist ltb style="mso-bidi-font-weight:normal"gt8008lt/bgt conflict affected people (ltbgt1438 men, 1808 women, 1275 boys, 1317 girlslt/bgt) and cyclone affected people (ltbgt653 men, 741 women, 349 boys, 427 girlslt/bgt) including children and persons with disability in Samee, Paletwa, Matupi, and Kanplet townships. We will target children’s education so that children will have the opportunity for learning their education no matter how the situation is dimmed and darkened. Family World is convinced of the fact that education is a key to development and every child should have the right to pursue their education. The project targeted is hard to reach conflict areas. Thus, Family World will form an implementing team for this project, and the implementing team will carry out the work of implementation. Well informed and trained implementing team will also work with local authority or community leading groups and religious leaders till the completion of the project. Thus, FW is aiming to achieve the following reasons: 01.lt/spangtltb style="mso-bidi-font-weight:normal"gtltspan style="font-size:8.0pt mso-bidi-font-size:10.0ptfont-family:"gt Education activitylt/spangtlt/bgtltfont face="arial, sans-serif, sans-serif" color="#000000"gtltspan style="font-size: 8pt"gt. Learning lt/spangtlt/fontgtltspan style="color: black font-family:"gt lt/spangtltfont face="arial, sans-serif, sans-serif" color="#000000"gtltspan style="font-size: 8pt"gtmaterials provided for school children regardless of race, lt/spangtcolorltspan style="font-size: 8pt"gt, and gender difference. Providing menstrual health and hygiene management items, and awareness raising on child protection etc. 02. lt/spangtlt/fontgtltb style="mso-bidi-font-weight:normal"gtltspan style="font-size:8.0ptmso-bidi-font-size:10.0ptfont-family:"gtFood securitylt/spangtlt/bgtltspan style="font-size:8.0ptmso-bidi-font-size: 10.0ptfont-family:"gt. Rice bags and salts will be distributed by cash assistance so that they will have enough food for at least for three months. 03. lt/spangtltb style="mso-bidi-font-weight:normal"gtltspan style="font-size:8.0ptmso-bidi-font-size:10.0ptfont-family:"gtNon-Food itemslt/spangtlt/bgtltspan style="font-size:8.0ptmso-bidi-font-size: 10.0ptfont-family:"gt (NFI). 03. Mosquito nets, toothpastes and toothbrushes, soaps and washing powders, torchlight, mats, and women sanitary will be delivered to targeted affected people. 04. lt/spangtltb style="mso-bidi-font-weight:normal"gtltspan style="font-size:8.0pt mso-bidi-font-size:10.0ptfont-family:"gtShelters. lt/spangtlt/bgtltspan style="font-size:8.0ptmso-bidi-font-size:10.0ptfont-family:"gtProviding emergency shelter support of reconstruction support which are affected by cyclone MOCHA and IDPs sites. lt/spangtlt/pgtltp class="" style=""gt
